RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBTST Admit Card 2026

Post Date: September 20, 2026

11:05 pm

Railway Recruitment Board (RRB), has released the CBTST Admit Card on its official website for the recruitment of Non-Technical Popular Categories (NTPC) Graduate Level Posts. The CBT-II exam was conducted on 10 July 2026, and the last date to submit the application form was 27 November 2025. Candidates can Check their CBTST Admit Card using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. (Advt No : CEN 06/2025)

Application Fee

  • For General / OBC / EWS : ₹ 500/-
  • For SC / ST / EBC : ₹ 250/- 
  • For All Category female : ₹ 250/- 
  • Fess Refund : General / OBC : Rs. 400/- will be refunded and Other candidates : Rs. 250/- will be refunded to the bank account after appearing in Stage I Exam.

    • Debit Card

    • Internet Banking
    • IMPS
    • Cash Card / Mobile Wallet
